description: This file defines the ReturnStatus class which provides methods for managing return status entities in the OpenCart system, including creating, editing, deleting, and retrieving return statuses and their descriptions.

classes.name: ReturnStatus
classes.description: A model class for managing return statuses within the localisation module of OpenCart.

methods.name: addReturnStatus
methods.description: Adds a new return status to the database, creating entries for each language and returning the new return status ID.

methods.name: editReturnStatus
methods.description: Edits an existing return status, updating descriptions for each language.

methods.name: deleteReturnStatus
methods.description: Deletes a return status by its ID.

methods.name: deleteReturnStatusesByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all return status descriptions associated with a specific language ID.

methods.name: getReturnStatus
methods.description: Retrieves a specific return status by ID for the current language.

methods.name: getReturnStatuses
methods.description: Fetches a list of return statuses with optional ordering, pagination, and filtering.

methods.name: getTotalReturnStatuses
methods.description: Returns the total count of return statuses for the current language.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description (name) for a specific return status in a specific language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for a specific return status across all languages.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Fetches descriptions for all return statuses in a specific language.
